references.text: The Lord foresees that Pharaoh will not let Israel go unless he sees God's mighty hand at work
God promises to show his strong hand against Pharaoh so that he will let the Israelites leave
God says he will perform many signs and wonders in Egypt, and the Egyptians will know that he is the Lord
Israel saw the mighty act the Lord performed against the Egyptians, and the people feared the Lord
Moses reminds them of God's mighty hand and outstretched arm, the signs and wonders that brought Israel out of Egypt
Moses recalls the signs, wonders, and strong hand the Lord used to deliver Israel
Moses urges the people to remember the greatness of the Lord, his strong hand, and all the deeds they saw with their own eyes
The confession that the Lord brought Israel out of Egypt with a strong hand, an outstretched arm, and great awe
God promises to perform wonders before all the people of Israel that have never been done before on earth
God testifies to Moses' unique role as a prophet, that he spoke with God face to face
Stephen testifies that Moses led the people out and performed signs and wonders in Egypt, at the Red Sea, and in the wilderness
